rows.description: BoxMOT: Pluggable Python and C++ SOTA multi-object tracking modules with support for axis-aligned and oriented bounding boxes

Trackers gives you clean, modular re-implementations of leading multi-object tracking algorithms released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license. You combine them with any detection model you already use.
A real-time multi-object tracking application in C++17 with Qt and ONNX Runtime that runs a YOLO detector with four pluggable trackers — ByteTrack, OC-SORT, Deep OC-SORT, and DeepSORT.
